novel_features.name: Conflict scan across linked calendars
novel_features.description: Find overlapping busy time across your Google, Outlook, iCloud, and ICS calendars during bookable windows — surfaces double-booking risk before it happens.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining multi-provider busy data with local bookings; Cal.com's API exposes busy-times per calendar but no cross-provider conflict view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When an agent needs to know whether a Cal.com bookable slot has an external calendar conflict, this is the only command that joins the data instead of doing N round-trips.

novel_features.name: No-show risk by attendee
novel_features.description: Rank attendees by historical no-show and cancellation rate from your local booking history.
novel_features.rationale: Local aggregation over the bookings table; the API exposes per-booking status but no attendee-keyed rates.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets an agent decide whether to require a deposit or reminder for a specific attendee before confirming a new booking.

novel_features.name: Attendee history
novel_features.description: Every past booking for a single attendee email — event types, statuses, first-seen, last-seen — with --summary collapsing to one row.
novel_features.rationale: Cal.com's API exposes attendees only inside individual bookings; cross-booking attendee view requires local joins.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents tagging 'repeat customer' or 'first-time prospect' use this instead of paginating /bookings.

novel_features.name: Schedule gap finder
novel_features.description: Contiguous free time of at least N minutes inside your availability windows.
novel_features.rationale: Local subtraction of bookings from schedule windows; /slots is per-event-type only.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents fitting an interview block or a focus window pick gaps directly instead of probing /slots per event-type.

novel_features.name: Reschedule replay
novel_features.description: Full chain of reschedules for a booking — every prior UID, who/when, with the final state on top.
novel_features.rationale: Recursive walk of rescheduledFromUid pointers across local bookings; the API exposes the field but not the chain.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When a customer asks 'what happened to my booking?' the agent traces the full trail in one call.

novel_features.name: Cancel sweep
novel_features.description: Find and (with --apply) cancel stale unconfirmed bookings older than a threshold. Dry-run by default.
novel_features.rationale: Local SQL pre-filter on (status, createdAt age) drives a typed cancel loop; the API has no bulk cancel.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents doing weekly hygiene get one command instead of paginating /bookings and looping cancel calls.

novel_features.name: Host load report
novel_features.description: Per-host booking counts, total hours, cancel rate, and no-show rate for a given ISO week.
novel_features.rationale: Local GROUP BY host_user_id; no API aggregation endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: RevOps agents building team-load reports stop writing Python pagination scripts.

novel_features.name: Load-by-day
novel_features.description: Sync one calendar day's bookings into local store and emit the delta (added/changed) vs the prior sync.
novel_features.rationale: Windowed /bookings call + upsert + delta computation against local state.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Targeted incremental sync for debugging a specific day without re-syncing the whole history.

narrative.headline: Every Cal.com command bcharleson ships, plus a local SQLite layer that answers questions the API can't: conflict scans across linked calendars, attendee history, no-show risk, schedule gap finder.
narrative.value_prop: 121 generated commands across Bookings, Event Types, Schedules, Slots, Calendars, Webhooks, Teams, OOO, and Conferencing — every endpoint in the Cal.com Platform API v2 OpenAPI spec, agent-native with --json / --select / --csv / --dry-run / typed exit codes. On top, eight novel commands that join your local synced state to surface conflict detection, attendee history, no-show ranking, schedule gaps, reschedule chains, and host load reports — none of which exist as Cal.com API endpoints.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set CAL_COM_API_KEY (or CAL_API_KEY for bcharleson compatibility) to your cal_live_* key from Settings → Security → API keys. The CLI sends Authorization: Bearer <key>. cal-com-pp-cli doctor verifies auth + reachability before anything else.

quickstart.comment: Pull bookings, event types, schedules, teams, OOO into local SQLite
Rank attendees by historical no-show rate — novel

troubleshoots.fix: Run cal-com-pp-cli auth status; ensure CAL_COM_API_KEY is set and starts with cal_live_.
The built-in AdaptiveLimiter honors X-RateLimit-Reset; rerun sync — it resumes from the last cursor.
Run sync --full first; conflict scan reads local calendars/busy and bookings tables only.
Some legacy bookings missing rescheduledFromUid; cal-com-pp-cli bookings get <uid> --json to inspect.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent needs full Cal.com Platform API v2 coverage with local-state superpowers: not just listing/creating/cancelling bookings, but joining bookings × attendees × event_types × calendar busy data to answer questions the API itself can't (cross-provider conflicts, attendee no-show rates, contiguous schedule gaps, host load reports). Prefer it over generic HTTP clients when offline aggregation, cross-entity queries, or batched operations matter.
